methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date (2026-06-13); CDN is billed either as a flat monthly plan or as usage-based bandwidth, so monthlyUsd holds the flat plan price where one exists and otherwise the published monthly minimum (or null when there is none), with the per-GB/per-TB rates and any volume tiers recorded in notes. Quote-only/Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null; HIPAA/BAA and minutes/calls/overage fields do not apply to CDN bandwidth and are null for every tier. Every figure is sourced to the fetched pricing page.

vendors.name: Cloudflare
vendors.provenance: https://www.cloudflare.com/plans/ (official plans page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat per-domain monthly plans with CDN included, prices shown for both annual and monthly billing)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever: unmetered CDN, unmetered DDoS protection, fast DNS, Universal SSL, free managed WAF ruleset, single sign-on and role-based account control.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: All Free features plus lossless image optimization and AMP; $25/mo billed monthly or $20/mo billed annually (~20% off).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: All Pro features plus PCI DSS 4.0 compliance and a 100% uptime SLA with 1x service credits; $250/mo billed monthly or $200/mo billed annually (~20% off).

plans.name: Enterprise (Contract)
plans.notes: Custom annual contract: all Business features plus 10x-25x uptime service credits and network prioritization. Quote-only.

limits: Free plan: no uptime SLA
Image optimization only on Pro+ plans
Workers free tier: 100k requests/day, 10ms CPU per request
PCI DSS 4.0 compliance only on Business+ plans
Phone support only on Enterprise contract
keyFeatures: Unmetered DDoS protection on all plans
330+ PoPs globally
Universal SSL/TLS on all plans
Managed WAF ruleset (free tier included)
Cloudflare Workers serverless edge compute
Lossless image optimization (Pro+)
100% uptime SLA (Business+)
ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS Level 1 certified
EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework certified
Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) DPA available
bestFor: Websites needing free CDN + DDoS protection with zero setup cost
Developers wanting edge compute (Workers) alongside CDN
Businesses needing PCI DSS 4.0 compliance at the CDN layer
Multi-cloud or platform-agnostic deployments
enrichment.provenance: Compliance facts sourced from Cloudflare Trust Hub (trust-hub/) and GDPR introduction page. HIPAA/BAA not stated by Cloudflare on any trust or compliance page found; marked null. SOC 2 Type II and GDPR (DPA with SCCs) confirmed by Cloudflare's own pages.

vendors.name: Amazon CloudFront

plans.name: Free (Always Free + flat plan)
plans.notes: Always-free tier: 1 TB of data transfer out to the internet per month and 10,000,000 HTTP/HTTPS requests per month, free.

plans.name: Pro (flat plan)
plans.notes: Flat-rate plan per distribution bundling the CloudFront CDN with multiple AWS services and feature allowances, with no overage charges.

plans.name: Business (flat plan)
plans.notes: Flat-rate plan per distribution with higher bundled usage allowances and no overage charges.

plans.name: Premium (flat plan)
plans.notes: Top flat-rate plan per distribution with the largest bundled allowances and no overage charges.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go (on-demand)
plans.notes: On-demand usage with no fixed fee: after the 1 TB always-free allowance, data transfer out is $0.085/GB for the next 9 TB in both US/Mexico/Canada and Europe/Israel/Turkiye. Requests (after first 10M free): US/Mexico/Canada $0.0075 per 10k HTTP and $0.0100 per 10k HTTPS; Europe/Israel/Turkiye $0.0090 per 10k HTTP and $0.0120 per 10k HTTPS. monthlyUsd null (no fixed plan fee).
